verdict.rationale: Shipping official SDKs is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The evidence only says Ubuntu is a primary platform for IDEs and AI/ML software and ships the latest libraries and toolchains. That describes hosting third-party developer tools, not an official Ubuntu SDK. The AT-SPI DBus interface listing is an accessibility primitive, not an SDK, and no item documents first-party SDKs for building against the product.
